result.instructions: Tools for TalentHR, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Who is on vacation next week, and who has a request still waiting for approval?"; "How many vacation days does Maria Ionescu have left this year?"; "Show our headcount by department and the hires and leavers of the last 12 months.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes TalentHR data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run talenthr_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run talenthr_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run talenthr_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. talenthr_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: talenthr_list_employees
tools.title: List employees (directory)
tools.description: List the company's employees from the TalentHR directory with name, e-mail, job title, department, division, location, employment status, manager id, hire date and phone. Paged (limit max 100): use next_offset to continue. Filter by location, department, division or employment status (emp_state) with `filter`; get the ids from talenthr_get_directory_filters. Use `custom_fields` to add extra field slugs (from the company's custom fields). Returns personal data; summarize only what the user asked for.

offset.description: Row offset, 0-based (default 0). Use next_offset from the previous reply.

filter.description: Filter: key=comma-separated ids, keys separated by ';', e.g. location=36;emp_state=1,2,3. Valid keys and ids come from talenthr_get_directory_filters.

custom_fields.description: Comma-separated custom field slugs to include, e.g. address,city,custom-field-001.

tools.name: talenthr_get_directory_filters
tools.title: Get directory filters
tools.description: List the valid filter options (departments, divisions, locations, employment statuses) with their ids, to build the `filter` argument of talenthr_list_employees and talenthr_get_calendar.

tools.name: talenthr_get_employee
tools.title: Get an employee
tools.description: Get one employee's profile: birth date, hire and termination date, personal e-mail, work phone, address, nationality, gender, job title, department, division, location, role, seniority and custom fields. Contains sensitive personal data (it can include the SSN); only fetch it when the user asked about that person.

tools.name: talenthr_get_employee_job
tools.title: Get an employee's job history
tools.description: Get one employee's job information: employment status history, manager records, job records (title, department, location over time), compensation records and benefits. Compensation is sensitive; only fetch it when the user asked.

tools.name: talenthr_get_organization_chart
tools.title: Get the organization chart
tools.description: List all current employees with their manager (reports_to_employee_id), job title and role, to answer who reports to whom.

tools.name: talenthr_list_departments
tools.title: List departments
tools.description: List all departments of the company with their ids (the ids are what talenthr_list_employees filters and employee records refer to).

tools.name: talenthr_list_divisions
tools.title: List divisions
tools.description: List all divisions of the company with their ids (the ids are what talenthr_list_employees filters and employee records refer to).

tools.name: talenthr_list_locations
tools.title: List locations
tools.description: List all locations (with address and remote flag) of the company with their ids (the ids are what talenthr_list_employees filters and employee records refer to).

tools.name: talenthr_list_job_titles
tools.title: List job titles
tools.description: List all job titles of the company with their ids (the ids are what talenthr_list_employees filters and employee records refer to).

tools.name: talenthr_list_time_off_types
tools.title: List time off types
tools.description: List the time off types (vacation, sick leave, ...) with id, yearly budget, whether approval is needed and whether it is paid. The id is needed to book a request with talenthr_create_time_off_request.

tools.name: talenthr_list_employee_time_off_requests
tools.title: List an employee's time off requests
tools.description: List one employee's time off requests (dates, type, days, approved or pending, canceled). Paged: use next_offset to continue. A request with approved=null is still pending.

offset.description: Row offset, 0-based (default 0). Use next_offset from the previous reply.

sort.description: Column to sort by: id, timeoff_type_name, created_at.

annotations.title: List an employee's time off requests

tools.name: talenthr_get_employee_time_off_budgets
tools.title: Get an employee's time off balances
tools.description: Get one employee's time off budgets per type and cycle: budget, original budget, used days and accrual figures, i.e. how many days they have left. Optionally limit to the current cycle (active) or one cycle id.

active.description: true = only the currently active time off cycle.

time_off_cycle_id.description: Limit to one time off cycle id.

annotations.title: Get an employee's time off balances

tools.name: talenthr_get_calendar
tools.title: Get the time off calendar
tools.description: Who is off when: employees with their time off requests and the holidays for a date range. Without end_date the range runs to the end of the start month (max 2 years). Without a filter it includes every employee (also terminated). Filter with keys time_off (pending, approved), department, division, location, emp_state and time_off_type (e.g. time_off=pending,approved;department=6), or one employee with employee_id.

end_date.description: Last day, yyyy-mm-dd (default: end of the start month).

filter.description: Filter: key=comma-separated ids, keys separated by ';', e.g. location=36;emp_state=1,2,3. Valid keys and ids come from talenthr_get_directory_filters.

tools.name: talenthr_list_holidays
tools.title: List holidays
tools.description: List the company holidays of a year (current year by default) with date and who they apply to.

tools.name: talenthr_list_benefits
tools.title: List benefits
tools.description: List the company's benefits with category, cost, dates and who they are required for. Optional `filter` with keys location, department, division, job_title, emp_state and employee (e.g. location=36;emp_state=1,2).

filter.description: Filter: key=comma-separated ids, keys separated by ';', e.g. location=36;emp_state=1,2,3. Valid keys and ids come from talenthr_get_directory_filters.

tools.name: talenthr_get_employee_benefits
tools.title: Get an employee's benefits
tools.description: List the benefits one employee has (category, cost, start and end date).

tools.name: talenthr_list_assets
tools.title: List company assets
tools.description: List the company's assets (laptops, phones, subscriptions, memberships) with status, category, serial number, cost, purchase and warranty dates. Paged: use next_offset to continue. `search` matches name, description or category; `filter` takes status and category ids (e.g. status=1,2;category=19).

offset.description: Row offset, 0-based (default 0). Use next_offset from the previous reply.

filter.description: Filter: key=comma-separated ids, keys separated by ';', e.g. location=36;emp_state=1,2,3. Valid keys and ids come from talenthr_get_directory_filters.

sort.description: Column to sort by: created_at, name, category, location, department, division, used_by, serial_number, warranty_end_date.

tools.name: talenthr_get_employee_assets
tools.title: Get an employee's assets
tools.description: List the assets (inventory and memberships) assigned to one employee. Paged: use next_offset to continue.

offset.description: Row offset, 0-based (default 0). Use next_offset from the previous reply.

sort.description: Column to sort by: assing_date, name, category, type, serial_number.

tools.name: talenthr_list_job_positions
tools.title: List job positions
tools.description: List the company's job positions (open and closed) with title, status, location, department, publish date and the hiring steps. The id is used to list a position's applicants.

tools.name: talenthr_list_job_position_applicants
tools.title: List applicants of a job position
tools.description: List the applicants of one job position with contact data, current hiring step and whether they are disqualified. Paged: use next_offset to continue. `search` matches first name, last name and e-mail.

offset.description: Row offset, 0-based (default 0). Use next_offset from the previous reply.

sort.description: Column to sort by: name, created_at.

annotations.title: List applicants of a job position

tools.name: talenthr_list_applicants
tools.title: List all applicants
tools.description: List every candidate across all job positions with contact data and the number of applications. Paged: use next_offset to continue. `search` matches first name, last name and e-mail; `starred_only` returns only the starred candidates (the talent pool).

offset.description: Row offset, 0-based (default 0). Use next_offset from the previous reply.

sort.description: Column to sort by: name, created_at.

tools.name: talenthr_get_applicant
tools.title: Get an applicant
tools.description: Get one candidate with contact data, description, CV info and all applications with the hiring step each one is in. The application ids are used by talenthr_create_applicant_note.

tools.name: talenthr_get_headcount_report
tools.title: Get the headcount report
tools.description: Headcount per month over a period (total and optionally grouped by gender, location, department, division, ...), plus the current headcount.

period.description: Reporting period: l12m (last 12 months) or a 4-digit year (the current or the previous calendar year). Alternatively pass start_date and end_date (max 36 months).

start_date.description: Custom range start, yyyy-mm-dd (use with end_date instead of period).

filter.description: Filter: key=comma-separated ids, keys separated by ';', e.g. location=36;emp_state=1,2,3. Valid keys and ids come from talenthr_get_directory_filters.

group_by.description: Break the headcount down by this dimension.

tools.name: talenthr_get_hires_leaves_report
tools.title: Get the hires and leaves report
tools.description: Hires, terminations and attrition rate per month over a period.

period.description: Reporting period: l12m (last 12 months) or a 4-digit year (the current or the previous calendar year). Alternatively pass start_date and end_date (max 36 months).

start_date.description: Custom range start, yyyy-mm-dd (use with end_date instead of period).

filter.description: Filter: key=comma-separated ids, keys separated by ';', e.g. location=36;emp_state=1,2,3. Valid keys and ids come from talenthr_get_directory_filters.

annotations.title: Get the hires and leaves report

tools.name: talenthr_get_time_off_report
tools.title: Get the time off report
tools.description: Approved, non-canceled time off summarized per month and per weekday, split by time off type, for a period.

period.description: Reporting period: l12m (last 12 months) or a 4-digit year (the current or the previous calendar year). Alternatively pass start_date and end_date (max 36 months).

start_date.description: Custom range start, yyyy-mm-dd (use with end_date instead of period).

filter.description: Filter: key=comma-separated ids, keys separated by ';', e.g. location=36;emp_state=1,2,3. Valid keys and ids come from talenthr_get_directory_filters.

tools.name: talenthr_list_time_tracking_entries
tools.title: List time tracking entries
tools.description: List time tracking entries across all employees (start, end, duration, tags) for a period or date range. Paged: use next_offset to continue. working_now=true lists only running timers. Needs a key whose user may see everyone's time tracking.

offset.description: Row offset, 0-based (default 0). Use next_offset from the previous reply.

period.description: Preset period (default today when no dates are given). Alternatively pass start_date and end_date (max 36 months).

working_now.description: true = only entries that are running right now.

filter.description: Filter: key=comma-separated ids, keys separated by ';', e.g. location=36;emp_state=1,2,3. Valid keys and ids come from talenthr_get_directory_filters.

sort.description: Column to sort by: time, started_at, ended_at, name, tag, location.

tools.name: talenthr_create_time_off_request
tools.title: Book a time off request
tools.description: WRITE: book a time off request for an employee (talenthr_list_time_off_types gives the type id). Unless preapproved=true, TalentHR automatically E-MAILS THE EMPLOYEE'S MANAGER to approve or reject it. preapproved=true auto-approves it when the key's user is allowed to (so no manager decides): only use it when the user explicitly said the time off is already approved. Dates must be within one year from today and inside a time off cycle. Optionally give amount_options (days per date: 1, 0.5, 0 for non-working days; every date from start to end needs a value); when omitted TalentHR works it out. Cannot be undone through this server.

preapproved.description: true = auto-approve (no manager e-mail decision). Default false.

amount_options.description: Per-day amounts keyed by yyyy-mm-dd, e.g. {"2026-11-02":1,"2026-11-03":0.5}. Must cover every date from start_date to end_date.

tools.name: talenthr_reply_time_off_request
tools.title: Approve or reject a time off request
tools.description: WRITE: approve (accept=true) or reject (accept=false) a pending time off request. TalentHR automatically E-MAILS THE EMPLOYEE the decision. A request that was already answered or canceled cannot be answered again. Only do this when the user explicitly asked for that decision on that request (find ids with talenthr_list_employee_time_off_requests or talenthr_get_calendar).

employee_id.description: The id of the employee who made the request.

annotations.title: Approve or reject a time off request

tools.name: talenthr_create_applicant_note
tools.title: Add a note to a job application
tools.description: WRITE: add an internal note to a job application (visible to the hiring team in TalentHR; no one is e-mailed). Needs the job position id and the application id (talenthr_get_applicant lists an applicant's applications with their job_position_id). Notes cannot be edited or deleted through this server.

job_position_id.description: The job position id of the application.

annotations.title: Add a note to a job application
